offline.banner: You're offline — showing the last loaded data.
offline.queued: Saved on this device — it'll sync when you're back online.
offline.outboxHint: These are saved on this device and will be sent when you're back online.
offline.emptyHint: Anything you save while offline waits here until it reaches the server.
offline.discardBody: It hasn't reached the server yet, and discarding it can't be undone.

discardDependents.one: One other queued change depends on this one and could no longer be sent.
discardDependents.other: {count} other queued changes depend on this one and could no longer be sent.

offline.itemFailed: Couldn't send — it will be retried.
offline.itemStuck: Can't be sent: the change it depends on is gone. Discard it.
